svg.title: Appendix A3: more monitoring tools, and the tools that act in Kubernetes from database data
svg.desc: Four more database monitoring tools, and three Kubernetes tools that react to database data: KEDA's PostgreSQL scaler, db-query-operator and Argo Events. Read from public docs, nothing installed or tested. None of the tools described reading the write-ahead log.

svg.text: The tools that act poll a query or consume events. We found none built to stop a workload on a change in the data's content.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: But the pieces compose: in our bench, Debezium to Kafka to an Argo Events data filter suspended a Job in under a second. It cannot say which Job.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: One run, local bench. Not checked: Kyverno, scale, a replicated Kafka. Notes: bench/experiments/argo-events-chain/RESULTS.md
